steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Sequence: An ordered list of numbers. Each number is called a term. | Two types of rules: Term-to-term: How to get from one term to the next Position-to-term: Formula for the nth term

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Generate the first 5 terms starting at 2, adding 4 each time. | Generate the first 4 terms starting at 1, multiplying by 2 each time. | Find the first 5 terms where uₙ = 3n - 1.

steps.title: Lesson 4: Exam Practice
